info.title: OpenFn Lightning REST API
info.description: The JSON API of OpenFn Lightning (app.openfn.org or a self-hosted instance), under /api: users, projects, provisioning, credentials, collection management, workflows, jobs, work orders, runs and log lines. The openfn adaptor reaches it with request(method, path)/get/post against {baseUrl}/api/{path} and a Bearer personal access token (configuration.access_token). Modelled from the Lightning router and API controllers at main commit 71ce1f0 (2026-11-05) and the vendor's API.md; operations marked x-lightning-unreleased are not in the latest release (v2.20.1). Cookie-session-only /api routes (AI assistant sessions, workflow health) are excluded because a bearer token cannot reach them.

bearerAuth.description: A personal access token (profile > Personal Access Tokens) or a service-account access token from POST /api/oauth/token.

page.name: page
page.description: Page number, from 1. A value below 1 or with no leading number is ignored.

project_id_query.name: project_id
project_id_query.description: Limit to one project. Required when the caller is the service account (400 invalid_parameter otherwise) on work orders, runs and log lines.

BadRequest.description: 400: invalid_request (unreadable Authorization header), invalid_parameter, malformed (body is not a JSON object).

Unauthorized.description: 401: unauthenticated (no bearer token) or invalid_token (unknown, revoked or expired token).

Forbidden.description: 403: forbidden (no permission, or the record may not exist) or insufficient_scope (token lacks the grant).

NotFound.description: 404: not_found (record or route does not exist), only to callers allowed to learn that.

Conflict.description: 409: id_taken, scheduled_for_deletion, concurrent_edit, being_edited, in_use or ambiguous_name.

ServiceUnavailable.description: 503: not_ready (adaptor catalogue still loading; retry-after 5) or service_unavailable.

NotImplemented.description: 501 not_implemented: not available on this instance.

ProblemEntry.description: One error entry in a problem document. Exactly one of pointer/parameter/header/path says where the problem is.

code.description: Stable entry code (an Ecto validation code or a Lightning entry code, e.g. unknown_key, taken, type, not_found).

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the request body, e.g. #/members/0/email.

path.description: Path segment name, e.g. id or project_id.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem document (LightningWeb.API.Problem). Sent as application/problem+json when Accept names it, application/json otherwise. Branch on `code`. Lightning releases up to v2.20.1 answered most API errors with ad-hoc JSON instead (the Unreleased changelog entry calls the switch breaking).

detail.description: Fixed human-readable explanation of the code.

scope.description: On insufficient_scope: the token grant the route needs.

example.title: Bad Request
example.detail: A path or query parameter is not valid. See errors.

PaginationLinks.description: Pagination links (URLs carrying the applied filters, page and page_size). next/prev are null at the ends.

members.description: Present on GET/PUT /projects/{id} only (main; not in v2.20.1).

Project.description: A project as a JSON:API resource object (LightningWeb.API.ProjectJSON).

User.description: A user as a JSON:API resource object (LightningWeb.API.UserJSON). Service-account tokens only.

Job.description: A job (workflow step) as a JSON:API resource object. Only `name` is exposed as an attribute (LightningWeb.API.JobJSON).

WorkOrder.description: A work order as a JSON:API resource object (LightningWeb.API.WorkOrdersJSON).

Run.description: A run as a JSON:API resource object (LightningWeb.API.RunJSON).

LogLine.description: A run log line (LightningWeb.API.LogLinesJSON). No links or relationships.

Credential.description: A credential without its secret body (LightningWeb.API.CredentialJSON). Links to projects the caller may not list are pruned.

schema.description: Credential schema, e.g. raw, http, dhis2.

name.description: Environment name; PUT accepts exactly one body named main.

PutCredentialRequest.description: Only these keys are accepted; any other is 422 unknown_key.

id.description: Must match the path id when sent.

owner.description: Owner email; applies only on create (service account only).

id.description: UUID; on create any client id, replaced by a new UUID.

Workflow.description: A workflow with its jobs, triggers and edges (Workflow.json_fields() minus state).

WorkflowInput.description: Workflow body for create/update. Lists sent replace the stored ones (triggers can be added or edited, not removed).

ProvisionedTrigger.description: Keys with null values are dropped.

ProvisionedEdge.description: Keys with null values are dropped.

version_history.description: <source>:<hash> heads, oldest first. Absent when a snapshot is returned.

ProvisionedProject.description: A project as a provisioning document (LightningWeb.API.ProvisioningJSON): the project fields plus workflows, project credentials, collections and channels, with UUIDs for idempotent redeploys.

ProvisionDocumentRequest.description: A provisioning document (see Lightning PROVISIONING.md): the project with its workflows, jobs, triggers, edges, collections and credentials, each keyed by UUID.

CreateUserRequest.description: Flat object; any other key is 422 unknown_key.

UpdateUserRequest.description: email cannot be changed; confirmed only ever confirms.

TokenError.description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint error (RFC 6749 §5.2), not a problem document.

PutProjectRequest.description: Only these keys are accepted; any other is 422 unknown_key.

id.description: Must match the path id when sent.

members.description: Applies only when the PUT creates the project; exactly one owner.
